GHA.note: Disability is an eligibility category for a cash grant only; nothing on information or digital access.

facts.fact: The LEAP Management Secretariat page says LEAP cash grants are paid every two months via the e-zwich platform with biometric fingerprint verification through GhIPSS and PayCode platforms, with a six-tier structure effective 14 September 2026.

systems.owner: LEAP Management Secretariat, Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection

GHA.note: Says households are selected from the registry and paid via GhIPSS, but not that systems exchange data.
Names no programme management information system; registry and payment platform only.

facts.fact: The LEAP Management Secretariat page says LEAP households are selected using the Ghana National Household Registry, whose database processes proxy-means test data to score each household.
